name: edit_file
description: Changes a file by replacing an exact piece of its text: pass path, old (the exact text to replace, copied from the file) and new. The match must be unique, so include enough surrounding lines to identify one place; the tool tells you how many times it matched rather than guessing. Pass create: true with content to write a whole new file. Read the file first with read_file: text reconstructed from memory usually differs in whitespace and will not match.

path.description: File to change, relative to the sandbox root.

old.description: Exact text to replace, copied from the file including indentation. Must occur exactly once.

new.description: Text to put in its place. Empty string deletes the matched text.

create.description: Write a whole new file from content instead of replacing text.

content.description: Whole file text, used with create.
